meta: A one-line product description like "pretty, good price" makes nobody stop to read. Mark asks AI to rewrite his silk scarf description: real details, a sample prompt, keywords, a final check.

muc.title: A bland description
muc.text: Mark opens a shop selling silk scarves. The product description is one line, pretty silk scarf, good price, and nobody stops to read it.

muc.title: Give AI the real details
muc.text: Bit reminds him: AI doesn't know your product. Give it the real details: material, size, colors, how to wash it, and who usually buys it.

muc.title: A sample prompt
muc.text: Sample prompt: you're a sales copywriter, the customer is an office worker. Write a headline, three benefits, then the specs, in under 120 words. That's role and output format from the series Getting results from AI.

muc.title: Add the words shoppers search
muc.text: Add to the prompt the keywords customers type when they search, like silk scarf for the office, so your product is easier to find.

muc.title: Read every word again
muc.text: Then read every word again. AI likes to add nice-sounding features the product doesn't have, like UV protection, and a wrong claim costs you trust.

muc.title: Rewrite your best seller
muc.text: Pick your best-selling product, give AI all the real details, ask it to rewrite the description, then edit it in your own voice.
